2. Import a server from SSH configuration and click Install remote agent. Linux requires vhci_hcd; installation and attachment need administrator privileges.

3. Select a server, select your board, and click Connect. Start flashing only after Mounted remotely appears.

只修改图示，不会断开现有 USB 会话。: Only the diagram changes. Existing USB sessions stay connected.
只发送文件，不调用烧录工具、不操作 USB。: Sends files only. Does not run a flasher or operate USB.
同一 USB 提供节点只能交给一个目标；多设备请添加独立节点: A USB provider node can serve one target. Add separate nodes for multiple devices.
此服务器上的同一 USB 标识已被另一条链路使用: Another link already uses this USB ID on this server.
固件传输：绑定目标并选择文件后，可在连线详情中发送。: Bind the destination and choose a file, then send it from the link details.
固件去哪里，USB 从哪里来，烧录在哪里运行。: See where firmware goes, where USB comes from, and where flashing runs.
导出会移除服务器绑定、文件路径与 USB 标识；节点备注仍会保留。: Export removes server bindings, file paths, and USB IDs. Node labels are retained.
拖动、连线、导入都不会建立 SSH 或接管 USB。只有点击检查或发送，才会访问: Dragging, linking, and importing do not connect SSH or claim USB. Only Check and Send access the selected server.
拖动节点标题；从右侧圆点拖到目标左侧圆点: Drag headers to move; drag output dots to target input dots
接收端 CLI 路径；Linux 和 Mac 留空使用默认值: Receiver CLI path; leave blank for the Linux and Mac default
接收端需要更新 UTA CLI: Update UTA CLI on the receiver
操作已结束或取消，请检查连接后重试: Operation ended or was cancelled. Check the connection before retrying.
此版本的固件接收端请选择远端节点: Choose a remote firmware receiver in this version
沿用本机客户端身份，文件按客户端和项目分别存放。: Reuses this client's identity. Files are separated by client and project.
确认文件校验完成和真实 USB 端口后，在此节点调用原来的烧录工具。: After verifying the file and actual USB port, run the existing flasher on this node.
箭头从插着设备的电脑指向运行工具的 Linux。固件无需传到 USB 所在电脑。: The arrow goes from the computer with USB to Linux running the tool. Firmware does not need to reach the USB provider.
节点系统与接收端不一致，请修改节点系统后重试: The receiver's system differs from this node. Correct the system and retry.
请先选择本机固件文件: Choose a local firmware file first
请先选择目标节点，将它绑定到已保存的服务器配置。: Select the target node and bind it to a saved server configuration first.
请在 USB 所在电脑的 UTA 接入目标服务器，并在目标服务器确认自己的设备端: Connect USB to the target using UTA on the provider computer. Verify your own device port on the target before flashing.
请填写 Windows 接收端 uta-server.cmd 的完整路径: Enter the full path to uta-server.cmd on the Windows receiver
请选择固件连线后插入中继: Select a firmware link to insert a relay
这是设备备注，不会仅凭标识接管端口。请在 USB 所在电脑的 UTA 确认实际接: This is a device label, not permission to claim a port. Confirm the actual connection in UTA on the USB provider.
这条连线会形成循环: This link would create a cycle
远端中继链路已规划。需在源节点配置目标 UTA，再从该节点发送；当前不自动执行远: Remote relay planned. Configure the destination in UTA on the source node and send from there. Automatic multi-hop execution is not available yet.
远端中继：需要源节点自己的目标配置；暂不自动执行。: Remote relay: requires a destination configuration on the source node. Not automatically executed yet.
链路文件不能是符号链接: Diagram file must not be a symbolic link
链路文件版本、规模或项目标识无效: Invalid diagram version, size, or project ID
链路目录不能是符号链接: Diagram directory must not be a symbolic link
链路文件必须是普通文件: Diagram must be a regular file
没有已授权的远程设备。请在提供设备的电脑上授权此客户端。: No remote devices are authorized. Authorize this client on the computer providing the device.
客户端标识已复制；将它交给提供设备的电脑授权。它不是密码。: Client ID copied. Give it to the device provider for authorization. It is not a password.
日志读取已结束，端口已释放: Log reading finished; the port has been released
已复制命令模板，请按项目原烧录工具替换路径和参数。: Command template copied. Replace its paths and arguments with those of your original flashing tool.
直接使用这个服务器上的设备，无需创建链路。刷新只查询状态，不打开串口。: Use devices on this server directly, without a link diagram. Refresh only checks status; it does not open serial ports.
单个串口自动选择: Auto-select only if there is one serial port
只在查看时占用串口；烧录前先停止日志。界面保留最近 64 KiB，不自动保存文件: Opens the serial port only while viewing. Stop logs before flashing. The view keeps the last 64 KiB; files are not saved automatically.
授权这台设备给其他客户端: Authorize another client for this device
仅授权这台设备的状态、工具执行和日志读取；不会分享其他设备或允许断开 USB。撤: Grants status, tool execution and log access for this device only, without other devices or USB detach rights. Revocation stops operations using this grant.
撤销会停止该客户端正在进行的日志或烧录，烧录中止可能需要恢复设备。: Revocation stops this client’s active logs or flashing. Interrupted flashing may require device recovery.
开始读取远程串口？: Start reading the remote serial port?
将按所选波特率打开这个设备的串口。打开串口可能触发部分板卡复位；请先关闭其他烧录: Opens this device’s serial port at the selected baud rate. Opening a port may reset some boards; close other flashing and log tools first. Stopping or leaving this page releases this reader.
